facts.text: The resort sits on Maundays Bay, a crescent-shaped cove on Anguilla.
facts.excerpt: Maundays Bay, a crescent-shaped cove on Anguilla

facts.text: Every room, suite and villa has a beach view.
facts.excerpt: Every one of our rooms, suites and villas boast a gorgeous beach view.

facts.text: Stays range from a beachfront room to a casita with a private pool to a five-bedroom signature villa.
facts.excerpt: Stays can range from a deluxe beachfront experience to an intimate casita with a private pool to a five-bedroom signature villa

facts.text: Villa host services are available 24 hours.
The resort has two tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: Stay active on our two tennis courts

facts.text: Yoga is held on the beach or in the gardens.
facts.excerpt: find your balance with yoga, held on the beach or in the verdant gardens

facts.text: Beach activities include paddle surfing, kayaking, kite surfing, sailing and snorkelling.
facts.excerpt: Paddle surfing, kayaking, kite surfing, sailing, snorkelling

facts.text: The spa is inspired by the Arawak tribe and serviced by Guerlain.
Spa treatments use locally sourced ingredients such as Anguillan salt.
facts.excerpt: use bespoke, locally sourced ingredients like Anguillan salt

facts.text: Pimms serves Anguillan dishes and Uchu serves Peruvian light bites.
facts.excerpt: Savour refined Anguillan delicacies in Pimms or Peruvian light bites in Uchu.

facts.text: The interactive chef's table is a nine-course feast.
facts.excerpt: learn what goes into each part of a stunning nine-course feast

facts.text: The Cap Shack is a toes-in-the-sand spot on the opposite side of the cove.
facts.excerpt: The Cap Shack, a toes-in-the-sand spot, is on the opposite side of the cove

facts.text: Nightly sabrage ceremonies are held in the Main House, where a select number of guests saber a bottle of sparkling wine.
facts.excerpt: The nightly sabrage ceremonies in the airy Main House, where a select number of guests get to saber a bottle of bubbly

facts.text: The owners named the property Juluca after the Arawak rainbow spirit.
A kids club keeps children aged 4 to 12 busy with educational and interactive activities.
facts.excerpt: that will keep anyone 4–12 busy with a full roster of educational and interactive activities.

facts.text: Specially adapted rooms are available upon request.
facts.excerpt: there are specially adapted rooms available upon request.

facts.excerpt: the best beach on an island famed for its phenomenal sandy stretches
